about: Yarmouth is a municipal district in southwestern Nova Scotia surrounding—but not including—the separate Town of Yarmouth. Acadian and fishing communities, Cape Forchu approaches, and countryside toward the Argyle district share the municipal district’s land. About 10,000 people live in the Municipal District of Yarmouth.
